blocks.source: Vol IV, The Physical Body, § Measuring a Machine's Own Limits
blocks.md: A brake that stops an unloaded base on a cool laboratory floor has not established how the loaded mobile manipulator stops after repeated maneuvers. Characterization must connect each calculation to measurements under the conditions in which the machine will use it. A dynamometer, a test stand that applies a controlled mechanical load, isolates actuator behavior, just as the instrumented propulsion test stand in a later section evaluates an assembled electromechanical powertrain under live aerodynamic and structural loads.

blocks.prompt: Think first: In two or three sentences, explain why Limit record matters for the system this section describes.
blocks.md: Compare your answer with the book's claim: A physical limit governs an admission decision only as a six-element record (value, conditions, uncertainty, margin, runtime detector, provenance with evidence category), and uncertainty about the measurement is distinct from margin held in reserve.

questions.q: The section **Measuring a Machine's Own Limits** develops one of the chapter's claims. Which one?
options: Gear compliance and backlash put lost motion and limit cycles between motor and load, so measured motor position is not the load's position.

An observation's age runs from physical transduction to actuator torque onset and must stay under the freshness deadline E_max / v_max set by the target's speed and the spatial tolerance, with inference only one of many stages.

A physical limit governs an admission decision only as a six-element record (value, conditions, uncertainty, margin, runtime detector, provenance with evidence category), and uncertainty about the measurement is distinct from margin held in reserve.
Impedance control makes a joint answer position error with the restoring force of a programmed spring and damper, which bounds contact force through stiffness rather than through position accuracy.
